meaning: A small plastic case holding magnetic tape on spools. It plays recorded sound, and you can record your own.
clues: It plays recorded sound from a thin ribbon of magnetic tape.
Its tape runs from one small spool to another inside a plastic case small enough for a pocket.
It was shown to the public in 1963 at a radio show in Berlin.
Many people made their own mixes of favorite songs on it for the car or a trip.
It has two words. The first has eight letters and starts with C.
assumes: An 8-track holds one endless loop of tape, not two spools
Reel-to-reel tape sits on open reels, not in a case

decoys.meaning: A plastic cartridge holding one endless loop of tape. It was popular for music, especially in cars, from 1965 to the late 1970s.
Magnetic tape wound on an open reel and played on a machine. Radio stations and archives used it for many years.
A hollow roll, often made of wax, with sound etched into its surface. Early phonographs played it.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: The cassette let you record and play your own mixes. Making a mix for someone is still a kind thing to do.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Today's version: a music app. You pick a song and it plays right away, with no tape to rewind.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Making a mix took a while, and finding a song meant rewinding. Worth it for a friend.
